title: 让 Agent 真正干活的协议、技能与审查层
opening: 今天的榜单几乎被同一件事占满：把编码 Agent 从聊天框里拽出来，接进真实工作流。最显眼的是 Chrome DevTools 的 MCP 服务器和阿里开源的代码审查工具，前者让 Agent 直接操控浏览器，后者用确定性管线加 LLM 做行级审查，都指向同一个问题——Agent 需要可验证的反馈回路。

projects.name: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
projects.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.

projects.summary: 一个轻量的事件协议，规定 Agent 后端如何向前端应用发事件、收输入，约 16 种标准事件类型。
projects.problem: 解决的是 Agent 与用户界面之间缺少统一接线的问题：后端按标准事件类型输出执行过程，前端据此渲染状态和交互。中间件层声称兼容任意事件传输，但生态成熟度仍需看各框架集成的实际覆盖。

projects.summary: 把 Chrome DevTools 包成 MCP 服务器和 CLI，让编码 Agent 控制并检查一个活的 Chrome 浏览器。
projects.problem: Agent 可以录性能 trace、分析网络请求、截图、读控制台报错并带 source map 栈，用 Puppeteer 做可靠自动化。真正值得注意的是它给了 Agent 可观测的浏览器反馈，而不只是盲写代码；代价是浏览器内容会暴露给 MCP 客户端，敏感数据场景要谨慎。

projects.name: alibaba/open-code-review
projects.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
projects.readmeExcerpt: OpenCodeReview English | 简体中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Русский What is Open Code Review? Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects. After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community. Simply configure a model endpoint to get started. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line-level precision. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews — not just surface-level diff feedback. Beyond diff review, `ocr scan` reviews entire files for auditing unfamiliar codebases or directories that have no meaningful diff. Visit the official website for more details. projects.summary: 阿里内部打磨两年的 AI 代码审查 CLI，确定性管线加 LLM Agent，输出行级精确的审查评论。
projects.problem: 读 Git diff 后由带工具调用的 Agent 读全文、搜代码库、看其他改动文件来补充上下文，内置 NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入等多语言规则集。README 称同等模型下精度和 F1 显著高于通用 Agent 且 token 消耗约为其九分之一，但这是自报基准，需自行验证。

projects.name: ggml-org/ggml
projects.readmeExcerpt: ggml Tensor library for machine learning Quick start Build from source: For a minimal, fully commented example (matrix multiplication), see examples/simple. Description The main goal of `ggml` is to be a simple, portable, and efficient tensor library for machine learning with minimal setup. - Plain C/C++ implementation without any dependencies - Cross-platform - x86, ARM, RISC-V, LoongArch, PowerPC, s390x, and WebAssembly - SIMD-optimized kernels for x86, ARM, and RISC-V - Broad backend support - CPU, GPU, NPU, and browser - 2- to 8-bit integer quantization, plus MXFP4 and NVFP4 microscaling formats - Zero memory allocations during runtime Documentation - The GGUF file format - Introduction to ggml - GGML tips & tricks Contributing - For changes to the core `ggml` library (including to the CMake build system), please open a PR in llama.cpp - doing so will make your PR more visible, better tested, and more likely to be reviewed
projects.summary: 无依赖的纯 C/C++ 张量库，跨 x86、ARM、RISC-V 到 WebAssembly，支持 2 到 8 位整数量化。
projects.problem: 定位是极简、可移植的机器学习底层，SIMD 优化内核覆盖主流架构，后端包括 CPU、GPU、NPU 和浏览器，运行时零内存分配。它是 llama.cpp 等地基型项目的基础，本身不提供模型或应用；核心改动要求提到 llama.cpp 提 PR，说明其开发节奏与下游绑定。

projects.problem: 把方法论、Web 应用狩猎、企业身份与基础设施攻击矩阵分层打包，并集成 Burp MCP，目标是让 Claude Code 按资深红队研究员的套路工作且不越范围。适合授权测试和靶场练习，但技能包再全也替代不了对目标业务的理解，误报和越界风险仍需人把关。

projects.name: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
projects.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
projects.readmeExcerpt: Modern Web Guidance (Source) This repo is the source repository for GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents. **Modern Web Guidance** is a set of skills that embed web platform expertise, best practices, and browser compatibility data directly into your coding agents. It helps to steer your coding agents away from legacy patterns, and instead toward solutions that harness the power and capabilities of the modern web platform. See CONTRIBUTING.md and GOVERNANCE.md for how we work on the project and orientation of the codebase. *Stewarded by the Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, and MDN teams, alongside the web development community.* Documentation · Eval Dashboard · Source Code · Report an Issue Quickstart This command runs an interactive wizard to install Modern Web Guidance. See Alternative Installation Methods below. Try it out (without installing) Why? Coding agents often default to older patterns because LLM training data contains vast amounts of legacy code. This often leads them to generate bloated JavaScript for tasks that now have native, high-performance web platform solut
projects.summary: Chrome、Edge、Firefox 与 MDN 共同维护的技能集，把现代 Web 平台最佳实践和兼容数据塞进编码 Agent。
projects.problem: 针对编码 Agent 因训练数据偏旧而默认生成过时模式的问题，用技能引导它改用原生、高性能的 Web 平台方案。由四大浏览器团队共同维护是它可信度的来源，但效果取决于 Agent 是否真的遵循技能而非凭记忆写代码。

closing: 今天的主线不是又一个 Agent 框架，而是给 Agent 装仪表盘和刹车：浏览器可观测、审查可定位、交付有审批门。谁先把反馈回路做扎实，谁才谈得上可靠。
